title: Corrected post-hoc analysis of E0029 after the static-feature fix
status_class: POST-HOC. The feature-extraction defect was fixed AFTER the preregistered run reported its outcome, so this is a corrected re-analysis of the same data, not a preregistered test. It cannot be reported as a primary result.

data_reused_not_regenerated.cost_avoided: no regeneration, no re-grading (91.4 min + GPU hours)

summary.gate3: FAILED -- the 25-feature model does not clear its null

model_comparison_allocation_point.note: fewer features win monotonically. With 34 positives each added feature costs more variance than it returns, and the size measures correlate hard -- seven of them is one signal plus six ways to overfit.

confounds.generation_cap: CLEARED. 0/162 samples at or near the 2500-token cap, so the signal is not an artifact of truncation.
confounds.difficulty: NOT CLEARED. Rescue rate spans 6.3x across difficulty (easy 0.467, medium 0.205, hard 0.074) and mean code length tracks it (18.1/36.7/62.8). difficulty ALONE scores AUC 0.707, better than code_lines at 0.651; code_lines within difficulty strata falls to 0.567. code_lines is largely a proxy for a stronger, free signal.
confounds.policy_value: calibration simulation gives +0.0450 [+0.0200, +0.0760] at frac=0.4 depth=+5, about 33% of ceiling -- but this is the SELECTED maximum over 25 operating points on the set it was chosen from, so optimistic by construction.

evaluation_set_status: UNTOUCHED. Gate 3 stopped before gate 4 on every run to date, so the 225 evaluation problems have never been scored. They remain available for exactly one confirmatory test.
verdict_rationale: The corrected analysis does NOT establish that a controller can allocate. code_lines clears its feature-search null by +0.005 at p=0.041, and is substantially explained by problem difficulty. The 25-feature model still fails gate 3. Nothing here is confirmatory and nothing was tested out of sample.
next: Decide which single feature to preregister -- code_lines (0.651, costs a generation to observe) or difficulty (0.707, free, but on FORBIDDEN_FEATURES and its provenance is unverified) -- then spend the evaluation set once. See preregistrations/PREREGISTRATION-E0030-code-size-rule.md, currently marked NOT EXECUTABLE.
